messages.author: 1da6fba54b1166e9
messages.subject: gl.filter.allna issue
parts:
Dear dartR team,

I would like to report that gl.filter.allna has stopped working after I updated R to the latest version. 
For reference, I have a SNP dataset scored as 0, 1, 2 and -. I've been using the same dataset for a year. I know I have 1 genotype scored - (or NA) across all loci and I used gl.filter.allna to remove it. Since updating to the latest version of R, the function has failed to remove the genotype. I have removed the genotype manually from my dataset and metafile, so I am not having any problems running my data, however I wanted to report the issue nonetheless. 

Best,
Juliana

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: gl.filter.allna issue
parts:
Hi Juliana,

Thank you for reporting this bug. The fix is now available in the developing version of dartR.base which you can install as shown below.

devtools::install_github("green-striped-gecko/dartR.base@dev")

Cheers,
Luis
